findings.title: check_work_activity hot-work/confined-space gates fail open on case/type variants
findings.description: Hot-work OSHA-1926.352 runs only when activity['type'] is exactly one of lowercase ['welding','cutting','brazing']. Capitalized or synonym forms (Welding, HOT_WORK, torch_cutting) skip the permit/fire-watch/extinguisher checks entirely. Confined-space OSHA-1926.1200 (CRITICAL) runs only when activity.get('confined_space', False) is truthy — activity type 'confined_space' / 'permit_required_confined_space' with the boolean omitted produces zero CS checks. Remaining PPE path only verifies helmet.
findings.impact: Hot work without permit/fire watch and confined-space entry without permit/attendant/atm test are reported as compliance-clean (helmet-only), enabling fire and asphyxiation incidents.
attack_path: Submit activity {type:'Welding', workers:[{ppe:['helmet']}], permits:[], equipment:[], fire_watch:False}.
check_work_activity returns only OSHA-1926.100 COMPLIANT — no OSHA-1926.352 row.
Alternatively submit {type:'confined_space', workers:[{ppe:['helmet']}], permits:[]} without confined_space=True.
Dashboard/consumers see no NON_COMPLIANT hot-work/CS findings → work proceeds without controls.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Distinct from already-reported fall-protection any(harness|guardrail) and unused excavation/scaffold/electrical rule objects. This is an active gate that fails to fire on realistic type casing / missing boolean, not a dead rule definition.
key_snippets: ATTACK type='confined_space' without flag → zero OSHA-1926.1200 checks

findings.title: AssemblySequencer ignores blocks_modules → dependent modules co-scheduled unsafely
findings.description: ModuleDesign documents blocks_modules as modules that 'Cannot install until this is done', but _build_dependency_graph only reads required_modules. calculate_sequence / generate_installation_plan therefore treat blocker-only edges as absent: foundation F1 with blocks_modules=['U1'] and upper U1 with empty required_modules are both degree-0 and land in the same installation level (order undefined within the batch).
findings.impact: Upper/structural modules can be crane-installed before supporting modules, risking collapse, dropped loads, and invalid MEP tie-ins during prefab assembly.
attack_path: Define ModuleDesign F1 with blocks_modules=['U1'] and U1 with required_modules=[].
generate_installation_plan batches both for the same day/crane window.
Field follows plan and lifts U1 without F1 complete.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Already-reported empty required_modules is the missing-edge case when neither field is set. This is the opposite: the documented blocks_modules edge is present but never wired into the graph — a distinct ignored-field fail-open.
key_snippets: blocks_modules: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # Cannot install until this is done
for dep_id in module.required_modules:  # blocks_modules never read

findings.title: check_envelope defaults compliant=True and passes on empty wall/window/roof lists
findings.description: ComplianceChecker.check_envelope initializes results['compliant']=True and only flips False when an iterated assembly exceeds limits. BuildingGeometry with walls=[], windows=[], roofs=[] (and arbitrarily bad floors) returns compliant=True with issues=[]. Combined with the already-known floor skip, omitting non-compliant assemblies from the submitted model yields a clean code stamp.
findings.impact: Energy-code compliance can be forged by omitting assemblies (or submitting an empty envelope), green-lighting permits/bids for non-code buildings and understated HVAC loads.
attack_path: Build BuildingGeometry with empty walls/windows/roofs and floors using U=2.0 (>> floor_u_max).
Export/attach result as ASHRAE/IECC compliance evidence.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Already-reported issue is that floor_u_max is never compared when floors are present. This finding is vacuous success on empty wall/window/roof collections (fail-open default), independent of the floor loop gap.
key_snippets: return results  # floors never visited; empty lists never fail

findings.title: ClashDetector silently skips elements whose geometry extraction throws
findings.description: _get_geometry wraps ifcopenshell.geom.create_shape in a bare except and returns None. detect_hard_clashes / detect_soft_clashes then `continue` when geom is None, never recording a failure or suspected clash. Elements with missing/broken representations, tessellation errors, or attacker-crafted IFC bodies that raise are treated as clash-free. get_summary can report total=0 while physical overlaps exist.
findings.impact: Hard clashes between structure/MEP can vanish from coordination reports → field collisions, rework, and struck-by/cut-in risks during install.
attack_path: Supply an IFC (or corrupt representations) where create_shape raises for one or both clashing elements.
_get_geometry returns None; both detect loops continue without appending Clash rows.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not the prior clash to_html XSS near-miss. This is a fail-open safety/coordination gate: geometry failure is indistinguishable from 'no clash', with no error channel in the report.
key_snippets: self.clashes.extend(clashes)  # may stay empty despite overlaps
